item.tib: tshe dbang drag khros kyi dbang chog byin rlabs sprin dpung
item.coloph: de ltar smin grol dbang gi rim pa 'di/ 'gro la sman phyir tshe dbang bdag gis sbyar/ rjes 'jug byang chub lam la 'god 'gyur cig skabs 'dir mkhan po g.yung drung gsal 'bar la/ gnyer gtad dbang bskur byin rlabs ces (gces) par bzung (zungs)/ skabs zhig bon chos nyi zla dar nub dus/ phyi rabs don du stong (stang) chen dmu tsha dang*/ bI ro la sogs grub thob rig 'dzin gyis brda ris bkod te (de)/ gter bdag ma btsan rnams kyis bya ra gzobs/ phyis su rten 'brel phun tshogs lnga shar tshe/ stong (stang) chen rnam rol las ldan gshen po yi/ zab mo gter gyi dngos grub rnyed par shog/ phyis su bdag 'dra thugs rje nyi mas phug leb 'o ma stag rtse gnas kyi g.yon mdun brag dmar snying gi dbyibs can nas/sman dri bzang po thul zhing tshig sgra dang bcas dngos grub tu rnyed ste (de) lo mang gsang rgya dam por byas/ slar smon sras rin po che dang*/ hor sras bsod nams rgyal mtshan mchog nas lha rdzas kyi (kyis) drangs te gsungs (gsung) nan che byung ba dang*/ nye gnas ye shes tshul khrims dang / g.yung drung 'od zer/ rgyal bstan sogs kyis bskul ngor/ gshen gyi bla brang du shog ser bod yig tu phab pa'o//
